newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas posts record employment for fourth month.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas posts record employment for fourth month.

text.p: Arkansas' unemployment rate fell to 5.2 percent in November, as the state marked its fourth consecutive month of record employment, the Arkansas Employment Security Department said last week.
"The record employment level, combined with the drop in the unemployment rate, are indicators that Arkansas' economy continues to show solid growth," ESD Director Phil Price said in a release.

The 5.2 percent seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was down from October's 5.5 percent rate, according to data compiled by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and released by the Arkansas Employment Security Department. Arkansas' November rate was also below the national rate of 5.4 percent, the release said.
